dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions (II)
dialogues.text: "Upon a sword one ascends on high, gazing out to lands afar..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions (II)
dialogues.text: "...Trees like jewels dot the hills, and the deep vales hide jade pools..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Swordsman's Inscriptions (II)
dialogues.text: "...Returning to find no further path, day and night there was weeping..."
